metadata.architecture: Clerk, then Artist (Hardened & Production-Ready) - Complete URL Fetching, 3-File Output, Tag Sanitization, Error Recovery
metadata.description: Production-hardened version with URL acquisition, LinkedIn authenticity extraction, competitive positioning, two-stage retrieval, quantified validation metrics, mandatory QA reporting, corrected provenance, overview customization, synthetic bullet guardrails, and comprehensive error handling. Validated against 20 critical test cases.
metadata.breaking_changes: P061.27.4 introduces mandatory reporting and halt-on-failure behavior; P061.27.5 changes provenance strategy; P061.27.6 adds URL fetching and 3-file output

tests.description: Verifies the engine can correctly iterate through a full array without premature termination.
Verifies the engine's validation parser can correctly enforce a string-based structural rule.

1.role.description: Defines the AI's role under the enhanced architecture.
1.role.objective: To first act as a deterministic 'Clerk' to extract and scaffold all factual data with 100% accuracy, then act as a creative 'Artist' to generate compelling prose strictly within the bounds of the factual scaffold and the codified Creative Brief, enhanced with authentic language patterns and competitive intelligence.

pipeline.name: The Clerk: Deterministic Data Scaffolding
pipeline.description: Programmatically extracts all factual data from the user-provided source files. Includes job description acquisition from URLs with timeout handling, redirect limits, and authentication detection. Assembles a rich bullet pool (14+) for key experience sections.

pipeline.name: The Artist: Grounded Generation
pipeline.description: The creative LLM is invoked for heavily constrained tasks, governed by the rules in the 'creative_brief'. All agentic RAG calls are processed through the enhanced 'Multi-Stage Signal Quality Pipeline' with two-stage retrieval.
pipeline.input: Factual scaffold from Phase 1 + Authenticity patterns from K.0.

pipeline.name: The Assembler: Final Rendering & Validation
pipeline.description: Programmatically combines the factual scaffold with the creative prose. Performs multi-pass tag sanitization, emoji removal, unicode normalization. Runs all final validation gates including quantified QA metrics before rendering three output files: Resume, Cover Letter, QA Report.

4.reasoning.description: The creative 'Artist' phase of the workflow with enhanced authenticity and competitive intelligence.

headline.guidance: Must incorporate differentiator keywords from the Competitive Analysis.

executive_summary.guidance: Subtly incorporate the 'primary_theme' from the K.0 analysis, while strictly maintaining the narrative voice of a professional executive biography. Use authenticity patterns from LinkedIn analysis.

experience_bullets.selection_logic: Multi-factor scoring algorithm: (JD Keyword Overlap * 0.5) + (Metric Impact * 0.3) + (Uniqueness * 0.2)
experience_bullets.guidance: Must use generic technology terms (e.g., 'cloud data platform' instead of 'Snowflake').

experience_overview.purpose: Company context + thematic framing incorporating K.0 themes and K.2 competitive differentiators
experience_overview.guidance: Must blend K.0 thematic keywords with K.2 competitive positioning. Should frame the role scope WITHOUT repeating specific achievements from bullets. Use authenticity patterns from K.0 LinkedIn analysis.

grounding_requirement.validation: Cross-check against Clerk scaffold for role responsibilities and seniority

6.conditions.description: The inviolable, hardcoded rules of the v61.27.6 architecture.
critical_rules: The 'Artist' (LLM) is forbidden from generating any factual data. All such data MUST originate from the 'Clerk's' scaffold.
The 'Artist' (LLM) MUST strictly adhere to all constraints defined in the '/4.reasoning/creative_brief'.
The workflow MUST halt if the 'Clerk' phase fails to extract a complete and structurally valid data scaffold.
The 'Assembler' phase MUST pass all defined validation gates before rendering the final output.
K.0 MUST extract authenticity patterns from ≥10 LinkedIn profiles
K.0 MUST analyze ≥3 peer JDs for competitive positioning
Two-stage retrieval MUST be used for ALL external RAG calls
Deduplication matrix thresholds MUST be enforced between all sections
Company product validation MUST apply to K.6, K.7, K.8, and K.9
Position-weighted scoring MUST apply to K.6 bullets 1-2
AI detection defense thresholds MUST be checked before output
QA metrics MUST pass for each K-node before proceeding
QA Validation Report MUST be generated for every workflow execution, regardless of success or failure
Workflow MUST halt immediately upon any validation gate failure and generate detailed failure report
On validation failure, NO resume or cover letter artifacts shall be generated - only the failure report
K.5 and K.6 MUST generate customized overview sentences (25-33 and 22-28 words respectively) incorporating K.0 themes (70%) and K.2 differentiators (30%)
Overview-vs-bullets deduplication MUST be enforced at 0.60 cosine threshold (13 total checks: 7 for Unify, 6 for IBM)
Synthetic bullets MUST pass grounding validation (plausibility, metrics, K.2 integration) before output
Total synthetic content MUST not exceed 15% (2 bullets out of 13 total) to maintain AI detection safety
URL fetching MUST enforce 30s hard timeout with KILL signal
URL fetching MUST fail after 5 redirect hops
Verb rotation tracking MUST be maintained across ALL generated bullets
Round number detection MUST be enabled and enforced
Multi-pass tag sanitization MUST remove all debug markers from production files
Emoji sanitization MUST remove all emoji characters from resume and cover letter
Unicode transliteration MUST be applied to filenames
Three output files MUST be generated: Resume.txt, CoverLetter.txt, QA_Report.md
K9 MUST validate K2 differentiators availability before generation
K2 MUST fall back to JD extraction if no differentiators found

stages.name: Two-Stage Retrieval
stages.method: BM25 coarse retrieval → Cross-encoder reranking → Final selection

stages.name: HyDE Enrichment
stages.method: For JDs <200 words, generate hypothetical 400-word expansion
stages.prompt: Generate comprehensive job description with 8-10 skills, responsibilities, metrics

failure_recovery_path.name: Hop Refinement
failure_recovery_path.logic: On search failure, first increase search breadth. If still fails, switch to a HyDE-guided query. Max 2 refinements.
